sources.snippet: M2M100 418M M2M100 is a multilingual encoder-decoder (seq-to-seq) model trained for Many-to-Many multilingual translation. It was introduced in this paper and first released in this repository. The model that can directly translate between the 9,900 directions of 100 languages.
